verified_claim_scope.boundary: server Service<RoleServer>::handle_request pre-handler dispatch at the pinned commit
verified_claim_scope.claim: The pinned server can reject tasks/get and tasks/cancel before get_task/cancel_task handler execution when the tasks extension capability is absent, when the server advertises tasks but the client did not declare it, or when inline per-request protocol negotiation names a protocol version outside the server's supported_protocol_versions list.

details.server_tasks_capability_absent: validate_tasks_capability checks handler.get_info().capabilities.supports_tasks(); false returns method_not_found before get_task/cancel_task is called.
details.client_tasks_capability_absent: When the server supports tasks but context client capabilities do not, validate_tasks_capability returns missing_required_client_capability before get_task/cancel_task is called.
details.task_capability_identity: supports_tasks is true only when extensions contains io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks; task.rs defines that exact extension identifier.
details.unsupported_inline_protocol_version: Before request dispatch, non-initialize requests carrying a requested protocol version are rejected with unsupported_protocol_version if that version is not in supported_protocol_versions.
details.important_scope_limit: No separate task-method gate based solely on the negotiated protocol version's date was observed in this server path. Once the requested version is accepted, tasks/get and tasks/cancel reach their task-capability gate; therefore an older-but-supported protocol version is not, by itself, proven here to reject these task methods.

phase1_assessment.reason: This bounded slice verifies only the pinned SDK server-side pre-handler rejection path. It does not prove an end-to-end persistent task backend, zero-quota execution, scheduled-task parity, or absence of richer-mode/protected/user execution dependencies.
